## Personalize Hibiscus, without slowing Settings down

- Choose the original Hibiscus icon or any of 19 alternate icons from Appearance. Alternate Dock icons now match the standard macOS visual size.
- Settings follows the selected note theme, with polished navigation icons and a more stable Translucency layout.
- Large OpenRouter catalogs no longer freeze Settings. Search still covers the complete catalog, while the screen renders a fast, focused result set.
- The installer window now shows the complete drag-to-Applications artwork without clipping.
